SELECTED PROJECT — AI travel assistant

EcoTour AI

A Python-based travel assistant for Pakistan with trip planning, bilingual chat, voice transcription, and live travel context.

View source on GitHub ↗
Focus
AI travel assistant
Stack
Python · FastAPI · Supabase · Whisper
Format
Project case study
The work

From problem to system.

The problem

Travel planning means balancing destinations, costs, weather, and local context across several disconnected sources.

The approach

The repository describes a Python API that brings budget-aware itineraries, English/Urdu chat, voice transcription, persistence, and live route and weather integrations into one experience.

01
Plan within a budget

Itineraries and cost estimates respond to a travel budget.

02
Ask in two languages

English and Urdu chat connects visitors to travel information.

03
Bring in live context

Weather, route distance, and hotel suggestions help shape a practical plan.

Some integrations require API keys and external services. This case study describes documented capabilities, not a claim of production traffic.
